name: Manai Tomoki
source:
"Is something wrong? You can talk to me about it if you'd like."

A man who was invited to the castle.
A timid but loving person who's nice to everyone he meets.
Since he's the oldest in the group, he tries to help out wherever he can.
He's so gentle that it seems like he would never hurt even a fly.
He's good at making sweets.
